subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: When a change to a locked feature is started while any task of its current plan is unfinished, the system shall refuse it and name each unfinished task with the remedy — finish it or cancel it.
rationale: No reopen while the current plan's tasks run (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-19)
fit_criterion: A reopen of a fixture whose locked plan has one unfinished task is refused naming the task and the remedy, and proceeds once that task finishes or is cancelled.
